# Board Configuration Reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/config/gen_board_doc.py from scripts/config/schema.py.
     Do not edit: run the generator. CONFIGURATION.md is the guide. -->

Every field a `BoardConfig.toml` may carry, the values it is accepted under and
what each becomes. `scripts/test/test_board_config.py` regenerates this file and
holds the generator's output to the golden headers under
`scripts/test/board_config/`, so a field cannot reach the firmware without a row
here.


## `[board_info]`

| Field | Accepts | When | Required | Becomes |
|-------|---------|------|----------|---------|
| `identifier` | letters, digits and underscores |  | yes | `BOARD_IDENTIFIER` in `board_config.cmake` |
| `name` | a string |  | yes | `BOARD_NAME` in `board_config.cmake` |
| `mcu` | a string |  | yes | `BOARD_MCU` in `board_config.cmake` |
| `mcu_series` | one of: `STM32F1`, `STM32F4`, `STM32H7` |  | yes | the header the file opens with |
| `chip` | a string |  | yes | `BOARD_CHIP` in `board_config.cmake` |

## `[led]`

One table per LED, the name of which is what the
firmware looks its macros up by.

| Field | Accepts | When | Required | Becomes |
|-------|---------|------|----------|---------|
| `<name>` | the board's own: a table named `rgb_strip` |  |  | `BDCFG_HAS_RGB_STRIP` |
| `<name>.pin` | a pin, `P<port><n>` (`PA0`–`PI15`) | `source` is set | yes | `BDCFG_LED_{NAME}_PIN` |
| `<name>.source` | one of: `TIM1_CH4` | `source` is set | yes | `BDCFG_LED_{NAME}_SOURCE` |
| `<name>.number` | an integer, 1 to 64 | `source` is set | yes | `BDCFG_LED_{NAME}_NUMBER` |
| `<name>.pin` | a pin, `P<port><n>` (`PA0`–`PI15`) | `source` is not set | yes | `BDCFG_LED_{NAME}_PIN` |
| `<name>.active_low` | `true` or `false` | `source` is not set |  | `BDCFG_LED_{NAME}_ACTIVE_LOW` |

## `[keypad]` — required

| Field | Accepts | When | Required | Becomes |
|-------|---------|------|----------|---------|
| `drive_mode` | one of: `io_direct`, `scan_matrix`, `spi_74hc165` |  | yes | `BDCFG_KEYPAD_DRIVE_MODE` |
| `active_mode` | one of: `high`, `low`, `none` |  |  | `BDCFG_KEYPAD_ACTIVE_MODE` |
| `drive_pins` | a list of 1 to 8 pins | for scan_matrix | yes | — |
| `sense_pins` | a list of 1 to 8 pins | for scan_matrix | yes | — |
| `key_map` | — | for scan_matrix |  | `BDCFG_KEYPAD_KEY_MAP` |
| `direct_pins` | a list of 1 to 8 pins | for io_direct | yes | — |
| `spi_chips` | an integer, 1 to 4 | for spi_74hc165 | yes | `BDCFG_KEYPAD_SPI_CHIPS` |
| `button_map` | — |  |  | `BDCFG_KEYPAD_BUTTON_MAP` and the rows beside it |

## `[usb]`

| Field | Accepts | When | Required | Becomes |
|-------|---------|------|----------|---------|
| `hw_periph` | one of: `ULPI`, `USB1`, `USB2` |  |  | `BDCFG_IF_<value>` |
| `speed` | one of: `full_speed`, `high_speed` |  |  | `BDCFG_SPEED_<value>` |
| `wired_report_hz` | — |  |  | `BDCFG_REPORT_RATE_HZ` |

## `[bus.uart]`

Validation and the lines are `bus_lines[UART]`'s: the
fields below are held to the rules, not emitted one by one.

| Field | Accepts | When | Required | Becomes |
|-------|---------|------|----------|---------|
| `bind` | a string |  |  | — |
| `peripheral` | one of: `UART1`, `UART2`, `UART3`, `UART4`, `UART5`, `UART6`, `UART7`, `UART8` |  | yes | — |
| `tx` | a pin, `P<port><n>` (`PA0`–`PI15`) |  | yes | — |
| `rx` | a pin, `P<port><n>` (`PA0`–`PI15`) |  |  | — |
| `baud` | an integer, 1 or more |  |  | — |
